verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a SaaS virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only UI channels (phone app, web portal, 'a few taps'), and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (all 404), so there is no evidence of any public API, let alone full UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
